lean.name: GlobalTheory.rowMainEqP_of_siegelWeil
lean.fidelity_note: `rowMainEqP_of_siegelWeil` uses Siegel–Weil and Bessel uniqueness to prove `RowMainEqP`. The latter has one index $u$ and estimates $Y.tO\,u\,u$. The prose attributes an off-diagonal main term to this declaration. The bound for two indices is stated separately in `pbApplied`, with further hypotheses.
